_note: Worked example: the 'Set for you' stall on mpaiva.com, before and after the fix (mpaiva/jupiter 0249bbb). The voice is picked by ear at the script gate; af_heart is the default until then.

lines.b-intro: This is the home page of [Marcelo](/mɑɹsˈɛloʊ/) [Paiva's](/pˈaɪvəz/) site, in Safari, with VoiceOver on. I'm going to listen to it the way someone who can't see the screen would meet it.
lines.b-goal: The goal of this test is simple. Can someone using VoiceOver understand this page, find what they need, and use its controls, without seeing it?
lines.b-steps: I test in six steps. First, I inspect the page structure in the code. Second, the keyboard on its own. Third, a reading pass with the screen reader, top to bottom. Fourth, jumping by headings, landmarks and links. Fifth, the controls themselves. And sixth, real tasks, start to finish.
lines.b-scope: Steps one and two come before the screen reader. In this video I'm on step three, the reading pass… and step five, the settings control.
lines.b-skip: The first thing it reaches is a skip link, which is a good start. That's [WCAG](/wˈʌkæɡ/) two point four point one, Bypass Blocks. Now I'll read the header one item at a time.
lines.b-setforyou: Set for you… a button, and it tells me it's collapsed. That's what [WCAG](/wˈʌkæɡ/) four point one point two asks for: a name, a role, and a state. Next item.
lines.b-menu: It says menu… and again… and again. Four presses, and it hasn't moved past it.
lines.b-why: There's no menu on screen. The settings panel is closed, but the four dropdowns inside it are still reaching VoiceOver. That's a problem under [WCAG](/wˈʌkæɡ/) four point one point two, Name, Role, Value: VoiceOver is handed a menu with no name, for something that isn't there. If you're listening, it sounds like the page has stopped, right at the control that sets the site up for you.
lines.a-fix: The fix is to leave the panel empty while it's closed. Here's the same page after that change. I'll go straight to Set for you.
lines.a-next: Collapsed, the same as before. Next item.
lines.a-pause: That's Pause motion, the next button on the screen. The silence is gone, and four point one point two holds here.
lines.a-open: And when I open it, the first setting reads out its name and its value… Drawings, in calm color.
lines.a-close: Same panel, same settings… it just stopped announcing things that aren't on screen.
lines.v3-open: Step three, the reading pass. The home page from the top, in Safari with VoiceOver, the way someone who can't see the screen would meet it.
lines.v7-open: Fix and re-test. The panel is now left empty while it's closed. I'll go straight to Set for you.
lines.v0-series: In this series, each step gets its own short video, on this same page. Along the way I find a problem in one of its controls… and the last video shows it fixed, and tested again.
lines.v4-open: Step four, structural navigation. Someone using a screen reader rarely reads every item. They jump, by headings, by landmarks, and by links. First, headings.
lines.v4-headings: One level one, a level two for the latest writing, and the essays under it at level three. The outline holds, all the way down. That's [WCAG](/wˈʌkæɡ/) one point three point one, Info and Relationships.
lines.v4-landmarks-ok: Each region is announced with a name, so I can tell them apart and jump straight to the one I want.
lines.v4-links: And links. In a list of links, each one has to make sense on its own.
lines.v4-doubled: Here's a problem. The essays in the drawing strip read their title twice, and then the whole summary. The purpose is clear, so [WCAG](/wˈʌkæɡ/) two point four point four is met… but a list like this is slow to get through.
lines.v5-open: Step five, the controls. Finding Set for you isn't enough. It has to say what it is, what state it's in, and work from the keyboard.
lines.v5-state: Name, Set for you. Role, button. State, collapsed. That's [WCAG](/wˈʌkæɡ/) four point one point two.
lines.v5-expanded: When I press it, the state changes to expanded, and VoiceOver says so. Now the panel, one item at a time.
lines.v5-selects: The settings read as a sentence, and each dropdown has its own name… Drawings, Theme, Motion, Home page… with its current value first.
lines.v5-escape: And Escape closes it, and puts me back on the button, collapsed again. Focus isn't lost.
lines.v6-open: Step six, a real task. I'll turn the drawings off, start to finish, with VoiceOver… and find out whether it tells me it worked.
lines.v6-found: There's the Drawings dropdown, set to calm color. I'll open it, and choose not at all.
lines.v6-stale: When I choose it, VoiceOver reads the old value… calm color. That seems to be VoiceOver in Safari with a standard dropdown. I have to ask again to hear what's set.
lines.v6-silent: Not at all. It worked… but nothing told me. The panel has a note about it, so I'll go and find it.
lines.v6-note: There it is. Drawings are off, and their captions go with them. That's a status message, and it's only on screen: it should be announced without me going to look. That's a problem under [WCAG](/wˈʌkæɡ/) four point one point three, Status Messages.
lines.v6-gone: And after See the work, VoiceOver goes straight to Latest writing. The drawings are gone for a listener too. The task works… it just doesn't say so.
